description: Create a shared code module (baseVersion 0) or write its next version (baseVersion = the version you read). The code is a FUNCTION BODY that returns the exports, e.g. `return { createShip(host, config) { … return {start, update, dispose, api}; } };`. It runs once per run with `this` undefined (it reaches no component: the importing script passes in what it needs) and the same globals as a script (Event, EntityManager, THREE, GraphicsThree). Variables at its top level are shared by every script that imports it; per-instance state goes in what its factory returns. A module cannot import another module. A write on an older version is refused with the current code, never merged. Projects that follow the latest version run the new one at once (open editors reload it); pinned projects and published releases keep their version. See "HOWTO_CODE_MODULES.md".

baseVersion.description: 0 to create the module; otherwise the version r3_module_read answered.

code.description: The module: a function body that returns its exports object (at most 250000 characters; comments and readable names are fine).

description.description: What the module is for (one line).

name.description: The module name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. "ship-core".

notes.description: What changed in this version (shown in the version list).

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.
